initial_receipt.explanation: The upstream provenance handoff is faulty. The criteria require preserving record identity and provenance so downstream can preserve upstream order. In job_1, assemble_provenance writes evidence_sources.record_id from source_id instead of the need record_id. Job_2 then correctly looks up ranks by coverage record_id, but the handoff contains source ids such as s01 rather than need ids such as n06-r01, so every observed upstream_rank is 0. The responsible localized fault is therefore upstream assemble_provenance, not downstream ranking logic.

terminal_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault introduced upstream. The downstream job consumed the two handoffs it was given, but the evidence_sources handoff contains record_id values s01 through s08 instead of the need record identities n06-r01 through n06-r08.
